title: Harden single-file pipeline launch source scope
summary: Implements the confirmed queue-launch finding that Local API/WebView single-file starts could forward arbitrary local file paths to the backend instead of requiring a configured source-root media file.
reason: Single-file launch crosses source/scratch/output and queue-launch safety boundaries. Operator-selected files must be existing supported media under SourceMovies, SourceTV, or enabled LibraryProfiles before a backend process is started.
behavior_before: Pipeline start forwarded any non-empty single_file string to the backend after generic launch checks. Preflight fixtures could advertise readiness for a missing file outside configured source roots.
behavior_after: Pipeline start validates single_file through the backend queue source-file policy before acquiring the launch lock or spawning a process. Invalid paths return structured command evidence and do not start the backend. Tests cover a valid configured source file, outside-root rejection, and preflight parity.
tests_added: Updated process-launch and preflight fixtures to use an existing configured source file
manual_validation: Read AGENTS.md, docs/CURRENT_PROJECT_STATE.md, docs/OPEN_WORK_CHECKLIST.md, docs/generated/PROJECT_INDEX.md, and docs/operator/NO_TOUCH_BOUNDARY_REGISTER.md before source edits.
Inspected generated summaries for source_inventory, pipeline_policy, pipeline_facade, and process-launch tests before source edits.
Verified the queue launch finding against current source before editing.
rollback_plan: Revert the listed queue-launch source, test, ledger, generated-summary, and packet changes only. Do not revert unrelated dirty worktree files or completed audio/source-scratch remediation packets.

implementation_ledger.risk_boundary_touched: Queue launch, source-root scope, backend process start

notes: This packet is scoped to QLS-001. QLS-002 and QLS-003 remain pending verification against the current dirty tree.
